{{Quote|Master Lysannis, you're accused of criminal activity under Supreme Law 8814, aiding and abetting an enemy of the protectorate. How do you plead?|Captain Dragen|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Supreme Law 8814''' was a law enforced by the [[Justicars' Brigade]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Rikael Lysannis]], an undercover agent of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], was accused of criminal activity under the law.
